attr.title: Super Smash Bros. Melee (native)
attr.desc: Native AArch64 build of the doldecomp Super Smash Bros. Melee decompilation, rendered through Aurora (GameCube GX on OpenGL ES) with the Aurora performance PR set and a direct GLES submission fast path. Renders 640x480 straight to the panel over DRM/GBM/EGL. Proven at 52-60 FPS on RK3566 (Miyoo Flip); other devices untested.
attr.inst: Place your own legally-dumped Super Smash Bros. Melee US 1.02 GameCube disc image (.iso, .gcm, .ciso or .rvz) in melee/assets. Saves are written under melee/runtime.
